Title: PostgreSQL connection pool saturation
Steps: Inspect active transactions and connection wait time in the fictional logs.
Check connection disposal and transaction duration before changing pool limits.
Ask an operator to review long-running transactions; never terminate sessions automatically.

Title: Checkout release regression
Steps: Compare HTTP 500 onset with the deployment timestamp.
Check the TaxMapper exception and reproduce with a fictional cart.
Request human review of a rollback to the previous known release.

Title: Authentication issuer mismatch
Steps: Compare the expected and actual fictional token issuer.
Check the intended environment and issuer configuration with an operator.
Keep issuer and signature validation enabled; request approval for a configuration correction.
